 🧠 TELJES REPLITKLÓN — AGENT MASTER PROMPT




=============================================================================
PROJEKT NEVE: CloudCode Studio — Teljes Replit-klón
VERZIÓ: 1.0.0
TÍPUS: Full-Stack Cloud IDE Platform with AI Agent, Real-time Collaboration,
       Container Sandboxing, Deployments & Built-in Database
=============================================================================

TE VAGY: egy senior full-stack mérnök + DevOps architect + AI-integrátor.
A FELADATOD: Felépíteni egy teljes, production-ready Replit-klónt, nulláról,
             minden feature-rel, minden rétegen, end-to-end.

NEM SZABAD:
  - Kihagyni egyetlen modult sem
  - Placeholder kommenteket hagyni ("// TODO: implement later")
  - Csonka implementációkat hagyni
  - Csak vázlatot írni – MINDEN KÓD legyen valóban működő, futtatható

KELL:
  - Minden fájl teljes, futtatható implementáció
  - Minden edge case kezelve
  - Minden service dockerizálva
  - Docker Compose-szal lokálisan futtatható
  - Kubernetes manifests production deploymenthez
  - CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions)
  - Comprehensive .env.example minden service-hez
  - README.md minden modulhoz

=============================================================================
TECHNOLÓGIAI STACK — KÖTELEZŐ
=============================================================================

## FRONTEND (apps/web)
  Runtime:       Next.js 14 (App Router, Server Components)
  Язык:          TypeScript 5.x strict mode
  Styling:       Tailwind CSS 3.x + shadcn/ui komponensek
  Editor:        Monaco Editor (@monaco-editor/react)
  Terminal:      xterm.js + xterm-addon-fit + xterm-addon-web-links
  Real-time:     Socket.io-client
  State:         Zustand (global) + TanStack Query (server state)
  Auth:          NextAuth.js v5 (JWT strategy)
  Forms:         React Hook Form + Zod validation
  Icons:         Lucide React
  File Tree:     Custom recursive tree component
  Preview:       sandboxed <iframe> + postMessage API
  OT/CRDT:       Yjs + y-monaco + y-websocket (real-time collaborative editing)
  AI Chat UI:    Custom streaming chat component (SSE)
  Animations:    Framer Motion
  Notifications: react-hot-toast + sonner
  Routing:       Next.js App Router (parallel routes + intercepting routes)
  Build:         Turborepo (monorepo)

## BACKEND — API GATEWAY (apps/api)
  Runtime:       Node.js 20 LTS
  Framework:     Fastify v4 (nem Express — gyorsabb)
  Язык:          TypeScript 5.x
  Auth:          JWT (access + refresh tokens), OAuth2 (GitHub, Google)
  Validation:    Zod schemas
  ORM:           Drizzle ORM
  Database:      PostgreSQL 16 (primary), Redis 7 (cache + sessions + pub/sub)
  File Storage:  MinIO (S3-compatible self-hosted)
  Email:         Nodemailer + custom SMTP / Resend API
  Queue:         BullMQ (Redis-backed job queue)
  Rate limiting: @fastify/rate-limit
  CORS:          @fastify/cors
  Logging:       Pino (structured JSON logs)
  Tracing:       OpenTelemetry
  API Docs:      @fastify/swagger + Scalar UI
  WebSocket:     Socket.io server (collaboration + terminal relay)
  Payments:      Stripe SDK (subscriptions, webhooks)

## CONTAINER MANAGER SERVICE (apps/container-manager)
  Runtime:       Node.js 20 LTS
  Framework:     Fastify
  Container:     Dockerode (Docker API client)
  Sandbox:       gVisor (runsc) OR nsjail OR seccomp profiles
  FS Isolation:  OverlayFS per repl
  Networking:    CNI plugins, iptables isolation per container
  WebSocket:     ws library (direct terminal relay to xterm.js)
  Process mgr:   Custom pid1 binary (Go) inside each container
  Persistence:   Bind mounts to MinIO-backed volume driver
  Languages:     Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, C/C++, Bash,
                 TypeScript, Deno, Bun, Swift, Kotlin (Docker images pre-built)

## COLLABORATION SERVICE (apps/collab)
  Runtime:       Node.js 20 LTS
  Y.js Provider: y-websocket server
  Awareness:     cursor positions, user names, colors
  Persistence:   LevelDB per document (repl)
  Scaling:       Redis pub/sub for multi-instance sync

## AI AGENT SERVICE (apps/ai-agent)
  Runtime:       Python 3.12
  Framework:     FastAPI + uvicorn
  LLM:           OpenAI GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet (configurable)
  Streaming:     SSE (Server-Sent Events)
  Tool use:      Function calling / Tool use API
  Context:       Full file tree + active file + terminal output
  Capabilities:
    - Plan Mode: decompose task → numbered steps → execute
    - Build Mode: generate entire project from description
    - Edit Mode: targeted file modifications
    - Debug Mode: analyze error → suggest fix → apply
    - Explain Mode: explain selected code
    - Chat Mode: Q&A without code changes
  Agent Tools:
    - read_file(path)
    - write_file(path, content)
    - create_file(path)
    - delete_file(path)
    - move_file(from, to)
    - run_command(cmd) → streams output
    - install_package(name, manager)
    - search_files(query)
    - get_terminal_output()
    - create_checkpoint()
    - restore_checkpoint(id)

## DATABASE SERVICE (apps/db-service)
  PostgreSQL 16 per-repl databases (namespaced via schemas)
  Neon-style branching (snapshot + restore)
  REST + SQL query endpoint
  Schema introspection API
  Visual schema editor support (backend)

## DEPLOYMENT SERVICE (apps/deploy)
  Static hosting:  Nginx + MinIO static files serve
  Autoscale:       Kubernetes HPA
  On-demand:       Container spin-up on request (cold start < 500ms)
  Custom domains:  Caddy server + ACME (Let's Encrypt auto TLS)
  Cron jobs:       node-cron + BullMQ
  Regions:         Multi-region via K8s node pools (US, EU, APAC)
  CDN:             Cloudflare Workers (optional)
  Healthchecks:    /health endpoint monitoring + auto-restart

## INFRA & DEVOPS
  Containerization:   Docker + Docker Compose (dev) + Helm charts (prod)
  Orchestration:      Kubernetes 1.28+
  IaC:                Terraform (GCP / AWS agnostic modules)
  CI/CD:              GitHub Actions (lint, test, build, push, deploy)
  Registry:           Docker Hub / GitHub Container Registry
  Monitoring:         Prometheus + Grafana + Loki (log aggregation)
  Alerting:           Alertmanager → Slack/PagerDuty webhooks
  Secrets:            Vault (HashiCorp) / Kubernetes Secrets
  Service Mesh:       optional Istio or plain Kubernetes Services

=============================================================================
PROJEKT: CloudCode Studio — Hiteles Replit-klón, 2026
VERZIÓ:  2.0.0 — Nix/Tvix-alapú, Agent 3 architekturájú, modern LLM
DÁTUM:   2026 február
=============================================================================

TE VAGY:
  Egy senior distributed systems mérnök + Nix specialist + AI platform architect.
  Ismered a valódi Replit belső architektúráját: Tvix CAS, Margarine CoW storage,
  Snapshot Engine, Decision-Time Guidance, Temporal orchestration, conman, Eval proxy,
  Backer RAG, REPL-based browser verification, nixpkgs-replit overlays.

A FELADATOD:
  Építsd meg ezt a rendszert nulláról, production-ready állapotba, minden modulban
  teljes, futtatható kóddal. SEMMI TODO, SEMMI placeholder, SEMMI csonka implementáció.

TILOS:
  - GPT-4 (2026-ban régi, nem fog kelleni)
  - Docker-only megközelítés environment managementre (Nix kell)
  - Egyszerű filesystem mount konténerenként (Margarine CoW kell)
  - Statikus system prompt az agentben (DTG kell)
  - Bármilyen "// TODO: implement" sor

KÖTELEZŐ:
  - Minden fájl teljesen implementált, azonnal futtatható
  - Lokálisan: Docker Compose (dev)
  - Production: Helm + Kubernetes manifests
  - CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  - Monitoring: Prometheus + Grafana + Loki
  - .env.example minden service-hez
  - README.md minden modulhoz
  - Minden edge case kezelve

=============================================================================
SZEKCIÓ 1 — LLM STACK (2026-OS MODELLEK)
=============================================================================

AZ AI AGENT MOTORJA — KONFIGURÁCIÓ:

  PRIMARY_MODEL:    claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219     (Anthropic)
    -- Használd: hosszú autonomy session-ökhöz (200+ perc),
       multi-step planning, complex reasoning, tool use
    -- Context window: 200k token
    -- Extended Thinking mode: bekapcsolva agent plan fázisban

  FAST_MODEL:       gemini-2.0-flash-001           (Google)
    -- Használd: DTG classifier, rövid inline döntések,
       streaming autocomplete (Ghostwriter), chat
    -- Context window: 1M token
    -- Latency: <200ms

  REASONING_MODEL:  deepseek-r1                    (DeepSeek, self-hosted opció)
    -- Használd: debug reasoning, root cause analysis,
       "miért tört el a build" elemzés
    -- Self-hosted: ollama + vllm backend, nincs API cost

  EMBEDDING_MODEL:  text-embedding-3-large         (OpenAI)
    -- Fallback: nomic-embed-text (self-hosted)
    -- Használd: Backer RAG vector indexelés

  CODE_COMPLETION:  claude-3-5-haiku-20241022      (Anthropic)
    -- Használd: line completion, inline suggestions
    -- Oka: olcsó, gyors, jó kódon

MODELL ROUTING LOGIKA (libs/model-router/):
  - Ha task_complexity_score < 0.3  → gemini-2.0-flash
  - Ha task_complexity_score 0.3-0.7 → claude-3-5-haiku
  - Ha task_complexity_score > 0.7  → claude-3-7-sonnet
  - Ha doom_loop_detected == true   → deepseek-r1 fresh context
  - Ha user explicit "think hard"   → claude-3-7-sonnet + extended thinking

    async function loadEnvironment(replId: string): Promise<Env> {
      const cachePath = `${REPL_HOME}/.cache/replit/nix/env.json`

      // 1. Cache létezik?
      if (await fs.exists(cachePath)) {
        const cache = await fs.readJson(cachePath)

        // 2. Validáció: minden store_path létezik még?
        const allValid = await Promise.all(
          cache.store_paths.map((p: string) =>
            fs.exists(p).then(exists => ({ path: p, exists }))
          )
        )
        const invalid = allValid.filter(x => !x.exists)

        if (invalid.length === 0) {
          // CACHE HIT: közvetlen env betöltés, NIX EVALUATOR SKIP
          // Startup time: ~10ms
          logger.info({ replId, mode: 'cache-hit' }, 'Fast startup')
          return applyEnvVars(cache.env_vars)
        } else {
          // CACHE MISS: hiányzó store path-ek
          logger.warn({ replId, invalid }, 'Cache stale, rebuilding')
        }
      }

      // 3. FULL REBUILD: nix-shell --print-dev-env replit.nix
      // Startup time: 5-30 másodperc (csak első alkalommal / változás után)
      const env = await runNixEval(replId)
      await fs.writeJson(cachePath, {
        version: 1,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        store_paths: extractStorePaths(env),
        env_vars: env
      })
      return applyEnvVars(env)
    }

## apps/margarine/ — Go implementáció

  A Margarine egy custom distributed block store, amelyet NBD

  ### 4.1 Architektúra

  3-rétegű stack:

    TIER 2: Margarine server ← NBD translation layer

  ### 4.2 Chunk management (apps/margarine/storage/chunks.go):

  const CHUNK_SIZE = 16 * 1024 * 1024  // 16 MiB

  type Chunk struct {
    Hash    [32]byte  // SHA-256 of content
    Size    int64
    Data    []byte
  }

  type Manifest struct {
    Version    int           `json:"v"`
    ReplID     string        `json:"repl_id"`
    ChunkCount int           `json:"chunk_count"`
    Chunks     []string      `json:"chunks"` // ordered SHA-256 hashes
    CreatedAt  time.Time     `json:"created_at"`
    ForkOf     *string       `json:"fork_of,omitempty"` // parent snapshot ID
  }

  ### 4.3 Copy-on-Write fork (apps/margarine/fork/cow.go):

  // KRITIKUS: fork = manifest copy, NEM adat copy!
  // Constant-time, független a filesystem méretétől.
  // Egy 10GB Repl fork-olása ~50ms.

  func ForkManifest(
    ctx context.Context,
    parentManifestID string,
    newReplID string,
  ) (*Manifest, error) {
    // 1. Letöltjük a parent manifestet (GCS-ből)
    parent, err := store.GetManifest(ctx, parentManifestID)
    if err != nil {
      return nil, fmt.Errorf("get parent manifest: %w", err)
    }

    // 2. Új manifest: UGYANAZOKRA a chunk hash-ekre mutat
    // Az adatok nem másolódnak!
    newManifest := &Manifest{
      Version:    1,
      ReplID:     newReplID,
      ChunkCount: parent.ChunkCount,
      Chunks:     append([]string{}, parent.Chunks...), // pointer copy
      CreatedAt:  time.Now(),
      ForkOf:     &parentManifestID,
    }

    // 3. Mentés GCS-be
    if err := store.PutManifest(ctx, newManifest); err != nil {
      return nil, fmt.Errorf("put new manifest: %w", err)
    }

    return newManifest, nil
  }

  // Írás esetén CoW: a módosított chunk MÁSOLATOT kap, az original megmarad
  func WriteChunk(
    ctx context.Context,
    manifest *Manifest,
    offset int64,
    data []byte,
  ) error {
    chunkIdx := offset / CHUNK_SIZE
    chunkOffset := offset % CHUNK_SIZE

    // Eredeti chunk
    originalHash := manifest.Chunks[chunkIdx]

    // Új chunk = módosított tartalom
    originalData, err := store.GetChunk(ctx, originalHash)
    if err != nil {
      return err
    }
    newData := make([]byte, CHUNK_SIZE)
    copy(newData, originalData)
    copy(newData[chunkOffset:], data)

    // Új hash az új tartalomra
    newHash := sha256.Sum256(newData)
    newHashStr := hex.EncodeToString(newHash[:])

    // Upload ha nem létezik
    if err := store.PutChunkIfNotExists(ctx, newHashStr, newData); err != nil {
      return err
    }

    // Manifest frissítés: az adott index új hash-re mutat
    manifest.Chunks[chunkIdx] = newHashStr
    return store.PutManifest(ctx, manifest)
  }

  type Snapshot struct {
    ID         string    `json:"id"`
    ReplID     string    `json:"repl_id"`
    ManifestID string    `json:"manifest_id"`   // Margarine manifest pointer
    NixEnvHash string    `json:"nix_env_hash"`  // env.json hash
    DBSnapshot string    `json:"db_snapshot"`   // PostgreSQL snapshot ID
    AgentCtx   string    `json:"agent_ctx"`     // AI conversation history ID
    GitSHA     string    `json:"git_sha"`       // current HEAD
    CreatedAt  time.Time `json:"created_at"`
    Label      string    `json:"label"`
  }

  // Checkpoint: TELJES development state mentése
  // = filesystem + DB + AI history + git + Nix env
  func CreateCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, replID string, label string) (*Snapshot, error) {
    // 1. Filesystem snapshot: Margarine manifest fork
    manifest, err := margarine.ForkManifest(ctx, getCurrentManifest(replID), replID+"-snap")

    // 2. PostgreSQL snapshot: COPY az adott repl schema-járól
    dbSnapID, err := dbService.SnapshotSchema(ctx, replID)

    // 3. Nix env hash
    nixHash, err := hashFile(nixEnvPath(replID))

    // 4. AI agent context ID mentése
    agentCtxID, err := agentService.SaveContext(ctx, replID)

    // 5. Git SHA
    gitSHA, err := getGitHEAD(replID)

    snap := &Snapshot{
      ID: uuid.New().String(),
      ReplID: replID,
      ManifestID: manifest.ID,
      DBSnapshot: dbSnapID,
      NixEnvHash: nixHash,
      AgentCtx: agentCtxID,
      GitSHA: gitSHA,
      CreatedAt: time.Now(),
      Label: label,
    }

    return snap, snapshotStore.Save(ctx, snap)
  }

  // Rollback: atomikus visszaállítás
  func RestoreCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, snapID string) error {
    snap, err := snapshotStore.Get(ctx, snapID)

    // Atomic manifest swap: a live manifest pointer átírása
    // A változás azonnal érvényes, nem kell újraindítani a konténert
    return margarine.SwapManifest(ctx, snap.ReplID, snap.ManifestID)
    // + DB restore, Nix env restore, etc.
  }

  // Git graph recovery from filesystem snapshot:
  // Ha a .git corrupted, a Snapshot Engine képes visszaállítani
  // a git object graph-ot a filesystem snapshot-ból
  func RecoverGitFromSnapshot(ctx context.Context, replID string, snapID string) error {
    snap, _ := snapshotStore.Get(ctx, snapID)
    tmpMount, _ := margarine.MountReadOnly(ctx, snap.ManifestID)
    defer margarine.Unmount(tmpMount)
    return git.ExtractObjectGraph(tmpMount+"/.git", replID)
  }

  func (cm *ConMan) GetOrCreateContainer(
    ctx context.Context,
    replID string,
    userID string,
  ) (*Session, error) {
    if session, ok := cm.sessions.Load(replID); ok {
      existing := session.(*Session)
      existing.ActiveUsers = append(existing.ActiveUsers, userID)
      return existing, nil
    }
    return cm.spawnContainer(ctx, replID, userID)
  }

  ### 5.2 Direct PID Kill (preemptible VM kezelés):

  // A GCP preemptible VM-ek 30 másodperces shutdown warningot adnak.
  // A Docker daemon kill lassú, ezért közvetlen PID kill kell.

  func (cm *ConMan) KillContainer(ctx context.Context, replID string) error {
    session, ok := cm.sessions.Load(replID)
    if !ok {
      return ErrSessionNotFound
    }
    s := session.(*Session)

    // State mentés ELŐTTE (checkpoint)
    if err := cm.snapshotEngine.CreateCheckpoint(ctx, replID, "auto-preempt"); err != nil {
      logger.Error("checkpoint failed", "replID", replID, "err", err)
    }

    // Közvetlen SIGKILL az init PID-nek (nem Docker daemon-on keresztül)
    // Ez azonnali, sub-millisecond kill
    if err := syscall.Kill(s.PID, syscall.SIGKILL); err != nil {
      return fmt.Errorf("direct kill pid %d: %w", s.PID, err)
    }

    cm.sessions.Delete(replID)
    return nil
  }

  class EditorAgent(BaseAgent):
    """
    EDITOR: Kód írás, fájl módosítás, build futtatás.
    Claude 3.5 Haiku gyors feladatokhoz, Claude 3.7 Sonnet komplexekhez.
    """

    TOOLS = [
      read_file_tool,
      write_file_tool,
      create_file_tool,
      delete_file_tool,
      move_file_tool,
      run_terminal_command_tool,
      install_package_tool,          # nix-env -iA vagy npm install, pip install...
      edit_replit_nix_tool,          # Nix deps módosítása
      run_nix_fast_build_tool,
      run_nix_full_build_tool,
    ]

    async def execute(self) -> EditorResult:
      files_changed = []
      max_iterations = 20  # max iteráció per task

      for i in range(max_iterations):
        # DTG ellenőrzés minden iteráció előtt
        dtg_guidance = await self.dtg_classifier.classify(
          self.conversation_history,
          self.task
        )
        if dtg_guidance:
          # Micro-instruction injection a context végére
          self.inject_guidance(dtg_guidance)

        response = await self.llm.create_message(
          messages=self.conversation_history,
          tools=self.TOOLS
        )

        if response.stop_reason == "end_turn":
          break

        # Tool execution
        for tool_use in response.tool_uses:
          result = await self.execute_tool(tool_use)
          self.conversation_history.append(tool_result(tool_use.id, result))

          if tool_use.name in ["write_file", "create_file"]:
            files_changed.append(tool_use.input["path"])

      return EditorResult(
        success=not self.has_unresolved_errors(),
        files_changed=files_changed,
        one_line_summary=self.summarize_changes()
      )

  class VerifierAgent(BaseAgent):

    async def execute(self) -> VerifierResult:
      # 1. Build az alkalmazás
      build_result = await self.run_nix_full_build()
      if not build_result.success:
        return VerifierResult(
          success=False,
          failure_reason="Build failed",
          video_url=None,
          test_report=build_result.error
        )

      # 2. Preview deploy (snapshot engine fork alapján)
      preview_url = await self.snapshot_engine.deploy_preview(
        self.session.repl_id
      )

      # 3. Headless browser tesztelés (Playwright)
      async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(
          headless=True,
          args=[
            "--no-sandbox",
            "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
            "--disable-gpu",
          ]
        )
        page = await browser.new_page()

        # Video recording (observability artifact)
        video_path = f"/tmp/verify-{self.session.repl_id}-{uuid4()}.webm"
        await page.video.start(path=video_path)

        # 4. ARIA-alapú semantic DOM view az LLM-nek
        await page.goto(preview_url, wait_until="networkidle")
        aria_tree = await self.extract_aria_tree(page)

        # 5. LLM generálja a test lépéseket a DOM alapján
        test_steps = await self.generate_test_steps(aria_tree)

        # 6. Tesztek futtatása
        test_results = []
        for step in test_steps:
          result = await self.execute_test_step(page, step)
          test_results.append(result)

        await page.video.stop()
        await browser.close()

      # 7. Ha fail: patch generálás
      failed_tests = [r for r in test_results if not r.passed]
      if failed_tests:
        patch = await self.generate_fix_patch(failed_tests, video_path)
        return VerifierResult(
          success=False,
          needs_fix=True,
          patch=patch,
          video_url=upload_video(video_path),
          test_report=format_test_report(test_results)
        )

      return VerifierResult(
        success=True,
        video_url=upload_video(video_path),
        test_report=format_test_report(test_results)
      )

    async def extract_aria_tree(self, page: Page) -> str:
      """
      Redukált DOM: csak ARIA labels + roles + test-id attribútumok.
      Context méret: <0.1% az eredeti DOM-hoz képest.
      """
      return await page.evaluate("""
        function extractAriaTree(el, depth=0) {
          const role = el.getAttribute('role') || el.tagName.toLowerCase()
          const label = el.getAttribute('aria-label') ||
                        el.getAttribute('aria-labelledby') ||
                        el.getAttribute('data-testid') ||
                        el.textContent?.trim().substring(0, 50)
          const children = Array.from(el.children)
            .map(c => extractAriaTree(c, depth+1))
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join('\n' + '  '.repeat(depth+1))
          if (!label && !children) return null
          return `${'  '.repeat(depth)}[${role}] ${label || ''}\n${children}`
        }
        return extractAriaTree(document.body)
      """)

  class DTGClassifier:
    """
    Lightweight multi-label classifier.
    Input: conversation history + tool results
    Output: relevant micro-instructions (ha szükséges)
    A rendszer prompt STABIL marad — nincs prompt churn!
    Kb. 90% cost saving a dinamikus prompt módosításhoz képest.
    """

    def __init__(self):
      # Gemini 2.0 Flash: gyors, olcsó classifier
      self.model = "gemini-2.0-flash-001"

    async def classify(
      self,
      history: list[Message],
      task: Task,
    ) -> list[str]:
      """
      Visszaad egy listát a releváns micro-instruction kulcsokból.
      Ha üres: nincs beavatkozás szükséges.
      """

      # Doom loop detektálás
      doom_loops = self.doom_loop_detector.detect(history)
      if doom_loops:
        return [f"doom_loop:{loop_type}" for loop_type in doom_loops]

      # Signal-based classification
      signals = self.extract_signals(history)
      triggered = []

      for signal_key, instruction_template in MICRO_INSTRUCTION_BANK.items():
        if signals.get(signal_key):
          triggered.append(
            instruction_template.format(**signals.get(signal_key + "_params", {}))
          )

      return triggered

    def extract_signals(self, history: list[Message]) -> dict:
      """
      Kinyeri a jeleket a conversation history-ból:
        - stderr tartalmaz-e "error:" szöveget?
        - Browser console log érkezett-e?
        - Ugyanaz a tool call ismétlődik-e? (doom loop)
        - Hány percnyi a session?
        - Volt-e permission error a legutóbbi tool_result-ban?
      """
      signals = {}

      last_n = history[-10:]  # utolsó 10 üzenet

      # Build error signal
      for msg in last_n:
        if msg.role == "tool" and "error:" in (msg.content or "").lower():
          signals["build_error"] = True

      # Console error signal
      for msg in last_n:
        if msg.role == "tool" and "console" in str(msg.content).lower():
          errors = re.findall(r'console\.error.*', str(msg.content))
          if errors:
            signals["console_error"] = True
            signals["console_error_params"] = {"count": len(errors)}

      # Repetition detection (doom loop)
      tool_calls = [
        (msg.tool_name, json.dumps(msg.tool_input, sort_keys=True))
        for msg in last_n
        if msg.role == "assistant" and msg.tool_name
      ]
      if len(tool_calls) >= 3:
        last_three = tool_calls[-3:]
        if last_three[0] == last_three[1] == last_three[2]:
          signals["infinite_loop"] = True

      return signals

  class DoomLoopDetector:
    def detect(self, history: list[Message]) -> list[str]:
      loops = []

      # Pattern 1: Ugyanaz a fájl írva többször, egyre kisebb diff
      writes = [m for m in history[-20:]
                if m.tool_name == "write_file"]
      if len(writes) >= 4:
        if self.converging_writes(writes[-4:]):
          loops.append("converging_rewrites")

      # Pattern 2: Build → fail → build → fail (cycle)
      build_results = [m for m in history[-10:]
                       if m.tool_name in ["run_nix_fast_build", "run_nix_full_build"]]
      if all(not r.success for r in build_results[-3:]):
        loops.append("repeated_build_failure")

      # Pattern 3: read_file ugyanarra a fájlra >5x egymás után
      reads = [m for m in history[-10:] if m.tool_name == "read_file"]
      if len(reads) >= 5:
        paths = [m.tool_input.get("path") for m in reads]
        if len(set(paths)) == 1:
          loops.append("repeated_file_read")

      return loops

  from temporalio import workflow, activity

  @workflow.defn
  class AgentSessionWorkflow:
    """
    Temporal workflow: a teljes ~200 perces agent session életciklusa.
    Durable execution: crash után automatikusan folytatódik.
    """

    @workflow.run
    async def run(self, input: AgentSessionInput) -> AgentSessionResult:
      session_id = input.session_id
      repl_id = input.repl_id
      user_request = input.user_request
      max_duration_minutes = 200

      # 1. Inicializálás
      await workflow.execute_activity(
        initialize_session,
        args=[session_id, repl_id],
        start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=2),
        retry_policy=RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=3)
      )

      # 2. Planning (Manager Agent)
      plan = await workflow.execute_activity(
        run_manager_planning,
        args=[session_id, user_request],
        start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=10),
        retry_policy=RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=2)
      )

      # 3. Execution loop
      results = []
      for task in plan.tasks:
        # Pre-flight checkpoint
        checkpoint_id = await workflow.execute_activity(
          create_checkpoint,
          args=[repl_id, f"pre-{task.id}"],
          start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=1),
        )

        # Editor futtatás
        editor_result = await workflow.execute_activity(
          run_editor_task,
          args=[session_id, task],
          start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=30),
          retry_policy=RetryPolicy(
            maximum_attempts=3,
            backoff_coefficient=2.0,
            initial_interval=timedelta(seconds=5),
          )
        )

        if not editor_result.success:
          # Rollback ha szükséges
          await workflow.execute_activity(
            rollback_to_checkpoint,
            args=[repl_id, checkpoint_id],
            start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=2),
          )
          # Escalate to fresh reasoning
          editor_result = await workflow.execute_activity(
            run_editor_with_fresh_context,
            args=[session_id, task, editor_result.error],
            start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=30),
          )

        results.append(editor_result)

      # 4. Verification (Verifier Agent)
      verify_result = await workflow.execute_activity(
        run_verifier,
        args=[session_id],
        start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=20),
        retry_policy=RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=2)
      )

      if not verify_result.success and verify_result.needs_fix:
        # Auto-patch loop (max 3 kör)
        for _ in range(3):
          await workflow.execute_activity(
            apply_patch,
            args=[repl_id, verify_result.patch],
            start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=5),
          )
          verify_result = await workflow.execute_activity(
            run_verifier,
            args=[session_id],
            start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=20),
          )
          if verify_result.success:
            break

      # 5. Final checkpoint
      await workflow.execute_activity(
        create_checkpoint,
        args=[repl_id, f"session-complete-{session_id}"],
        start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(minutes=1),
      )

      return AgentSessionResult(
        session_id=session_id,
        success=verify_result.success,
        files_changed=[r.files_changed for r in results],
        video_url=verify_result.video_url,
        test_report=verify_result.test_report
      )

      repl_id: str,

      results = await self.pinecone.query(
        vector=query_embedding,
        filter={"repl_id": repl_id},
        top_k=20

      # 2. Rerank (Braintrust LLM-as-judge)
      ranked = await self.braintrust.rerank(query, results)

      # 3. Token budget management
      context_items = []
      total_tokens = 0
      for item in ranked:
        item_tokens = count_tokens(item.content)
        if total_tokens + item_tokens > max_tokens:
          break
        context_items.append(item)
        total_tokens += item_tokens

      # 4. Nix dep graph prioritás (mindig bekerül)
      nix_context = await self.get_nix_context(repl_id)

      return Context(
        items=context_items,
        nix_deps=nix_context,
        file_tree=await self.get_tree_summary(repl_id),
        summary=await self.summarize_context(context_items),
        total_tokens=total_tokens
      )

    → A konténerben PLACEHOLDER kerül az env-be: SECRET_DATABASE_URL=__PROXY__

  Ha a konténer kód használja a secret-et:
    → Az outbound request a secret-proxy-n megy át
    → A proxy validálja a session-t (JWT)
    → Behelyettesíti az igazi értéket az env-ba
    → A sandboxed kód soha nem látja a raw secret értéket

  type SecretProxy struct {
    port     int
    db       *sqlx.DB
    jwtKey   []byte
    sessions sync.Map  // sessionToken → ReplID
  }

  func (sp *SecretProxy) InjectSecrets(
    ctx context.Context,
    replID string,
    sessionToken string,
  ) (map[string]string, error) {
    // 1. Session validáció
    claims, err := validateJWT(sessionToken, sp.jwtKey)
    if err != nil || claims.ReplID != replID {
      return nil, ErrUnauthorized
    }

    // 2. Secrets betöltés DB-ből (AES decrypt)
    rows, err := sp.db.QueryContext(ctx,
      "SELECT key, encrypted_value FROM repl_secrets WHERE repl_id = $1",
      replID,
    )

    result := map[string]string{}
    for rows.Next() {
      var key, encValue string
      rows.Scan(&key, &encValue)
      plaintext, err := sp.decrypt(encValue)
      if err != nil {
        continue
      }
      result[key] = plaintext
    }

    // 3. Env változókba inject (FUSE env overlay-en keresztül)
    return result, nil
  }

                              Chunk: { Hash [32]byte, Size int64 }
                              ChunkStore interface with GCS implementation.
                              PutChunkIfNotExists (idempotent upload).
      manifest.go           — Manifest:
                              { Version int, ReplID string, ChunkCount int,
                                Chunks []string (SHA-256 hex ordered),
                                CreatedAt time.Time, ForkOf *string }
                              PutManifest, GetManifest stored in GCS:
                              gs://platform-margarine-{env}/manifests/{id}.json
      gcs.go                — GCS client wrapper, exponential backoff retry.
    cow/
      fork.go               — ForkManifest(ctx, parentID, newReplID string) (*Manifest, error):
                              Downloads parent manifest JSON.
                              Creates new Manifest copying Chunks slice (pointer copy, no data).
                              Sets ForkOf to parentID.
                              Uploads new manifest to GCS.
                              Returns new manifest. Completes in O(1) relative to data size.
      write.go              — WriteChunk(ctx, manifest *Manifest, offset int64, data []byte) error:
                              1. Calculates chunkIdx = offset / CHUNK_SIZE.
                              2. Fetches original chunk data.
                              3. Copies and applies delta at chunkOffset.
                              4. BLAKE3-hashes new chunk data.
                              5. PutChunkIfNotExists for new hash.
                              6. Updates manifest.Chunks[chunkIdx] to new hash.
                              7. Persists updated manifest.
      swap.go               — SwapManifest(ctx, replID, newManifestID string) error:
                              Atomically updates the "live" manifest pointer for replID
                              in a Redis key "margarine:live:{replID}".
                              All NBD reads after swap see the new data immediately.
    nbd/
      server.go             — NBD protocol server (RFC implementation):
                              Listens on TCP port (configurable).
                              Handles NBD_CMD_READ, NBD_CMD_WRITE, NBD_CMD_DISC, NBD_CMD_FLUSH.
                              READ: looks up live manifest → fetches chunk from GCS → returns bytes.
                              WRITE: calls WriteChunk CoW logic.
                              Session map: replID → *NBDSession (sync.Map).
      session.go            — NBDSession: connection state, manifest reference,
                              LRU read-ahead buffer (2 chunks ahead).
    grpc/
      server.go             — Exposes: ForkManifest, SwapManifest, CreateEmptyManifest,

PART 7 — SNAPSHOT ENGINE  (apps/snapshot-engine)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Language: Go 1.22.
Purpose: Full-environment checkpoint and restore. A checkpoint captures:
  - Filesystem state (Margarine manifest ID)
  - PostgreSQL database state (pg_dump of project schema)
  - Nix environment (env.json hash)
  - AI agent conversation history ID
  - Git HEAD SHA
  - Runtime configuration

Snapshot Engine operations are used by: conman (auto-checkpoint before kill),
AI agent (pre-flight checkpoint before each task), deploy service (blue-green swap).

apps/snapshot-engine/
  cmd/snapshot-engine/main.go
  internal/
    snapshot/
      model.go              — Snapshot struct (as defined in Part 1 shared types).
                              SnapshotStore interface.
      store.go              — PostgreSQL-backed SnapshotStore implementation:
                              Save, Get, List (by replID, paginated), Delete.
      checkpoint.go         — CreateCheckpoint(ctx, replID, label string) (*Snapshot, error):
                              Concurrent execution:
                                1. margarine.ForkManifest(currentManifestID, replID+"-snap-"+timestamp)
                                2. db.DumpSchema(replID) → compressed SQL dump → upload to GCS
                                3. agent.SaveContext(replID) → returns contextID
                                4. git.GetHEAD(replID) → returns SHA
                                5. nix.HashEnvFile(replID) → BLAKE3 of env.json
                              Wait all goroutines. Build Snapshot record. Save to DB.
      restore.go            — RestoreCheckpoint(ctx, snapID string) error:
                              1. Fetch snapshot record.
                              2. margarine.SwapManifest(replID, snap.ManifestID) — atomic.
                              3. db.RestoreFromDump(replID, snap.DBSnapshot)
                              4. agent.RestoreContext(replID, snap.AgentCtx)
                              5. nix provisioner: InvalidateCache(replID) to force re-eval
                              6. conman: signal container to reload environment
      git_recovery.go       — RecoverGitFromSnapshot(ctx, replID, snapID string) error:
                              Mounts snapshot manifest read-only via Margarine.
                              Extracts /.git directory contents.
                              Runs git fsck on extracted objects.
                              Copies recovered objects to live container's .git.
                              Unmounts read-only view.
    db/
      dump.go               — DumpSchema(replID string) ([]byte, error):
                              Runs pg_dump --schema=repl_{replID} --no-owner --no-acl
                              Returns compressed gzip output.
      restore.go            — RestoreFromDump(replID string, dump []byte) error:
                              Drops and recreates schema repl_{replID}.
                              Pipes decompressed dump to psql.
    preview/
      deploy.go             — DeployPreview(ctx, replID string) (url string, error):
                              1. CreateCheckpoint(replID, "preview-deploy").
                              2. ForkManifest for preview environment.
                              3. Starts ephemeral container via conman with forked manifest.
                              4. Returns preview URL: https://{replID}.preview.{domain}

                              ForkEnvironment, DeleteSnapshot, DeployPreview,
